title: Wolfenstein II: The New Colossus
description: A story-driven first-person shooter adapted to Nintendo Switch, featuring motion aiming, a full single-player campaign, and large-scale combat against a fictional fascist regime. The protagonist continues the alternate-history conflict after the events of The New Order. The campaign’s final chapters build around resistance operations and high-intensity assaults.

gameplayPillars.title: Fast first-person gunplay
gameplayPillars.description: Dual wielding, heavy weapons, stealth, and aggressive movement support several combat approaches.

gameplayPillars.title: Story-focused campaign
gameplayPillars.description: The game follows BJ Blazkowicz through a heavily cinematic single-player campaign.

gameplayPillars.title: Weapon upgrades
